finalText:
**Fixed. Build passes now.**

The real error was in `src/core/settings.js` — `resolveConfig` referenced a variable `retries` that was never defined, instead of `env.retries`. That threw and killed the link stage.

I changed it to `maxRetries: env.retries || 3`. Build now exits 0: "build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors." Those 3 warnings are pre-existing (a deprecated crypto call, an unused export, a circular import) — none of them block the build, so I left them alone unless you want those cleaned up too.
